answer: An operator that abandons 129 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the raven forfeiture makes public up in the kernel totals with the spiral audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 19% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
